ctaHeading: Ready for Your Dream Renovation in Heidelberg?
aboutText: At Heidelberg Luxury Bath & Kitchen Renovations, we bring years of experience to transform homes across Heidelberg and surrounding suburbs. Based at 486 Lower Heidelberg Rd, our team delivers high-end bathroom and kitchen renovations with meticulous attention to detail. We operate from 9 am to 5 pm, Monday to Friday, ensuring timely and professional service for every project. Our portfolio showcases numerous completed projects, highlighting our expertise in creating bespoke spaces that blend functionality with elegance.
servicesText: We offer comprehensive renovation services for bathrooms and kitchens in Heidelberg. From initial design to final installation, our team handles tiling, plumbing, cabinetry, and project management to deliver stunning results tailored to your needs.
